questions.q: What does an Account object represent?
options: The company or organization Salesforce is tracking a relationship with
A single individual's contact information only, never a company
A support ticket
A marketing initiative
questions.explain: Account represents a company or organization — a customer, prospect, or partner.

questions.q: What is a Business Account, per this lesson?
options: The standard Account type, representing a company with one or more related Contacts
An Account type only used for individual consumers
A deprecated Account type no longer supported
A synonym for Opportunity
questions.explain: Business Account is the standard, default case — a company with its own name, industry, and related Contacts.

options: An optional feature (not on by default) that merges what would be a separate Account and Contact into one record for an individual consumer
A required feature enabled in every Salesforce org by default
A type of Lead specifically for referrals
A field on the standard Account object
questions.explain: Person Accounts must be enabled by an admin and are used in B2C contexts where the customer is an individual, not a company.

questions.q: Why would calculating "average Contacts per Account" be misleading in an org with Person Accounts enabled?
options: Because some "Account" records actually represent individual people rather than companies, skewing the average
Because Person Accounts cannot have any Contacts at all, always
Because Business Accounts never have more than one Contact
Because Person Accounts and Business Accounts are stored in entirely separate, unrelated systems
questions.explain: Mixing Person Accounts (representing one person) with Business Accounts (representing companies with many Contacts) distorts an average calculated across both.

questions.q: Why is Account often described as the natural anchor for company-level analysis?
options: Because so many other objects (Contacts, Opportunities, Cases) relate directly back to Account
Because Account is the only object that can be queried
Because Account records cannot be related to any other object
Because Account is a synonym for Lead
questions.explain: Contacts, Opportunities, and Cases all tie back to Account, making it the natural starting point for company-level questions.
